name: Cybermanju Drive
description: Quantum-resistant encrypted file manager with AI face grouping, triple-layer compression, code intelligence, GPS map view, web dashboard, multi-user access control, cross-platform cloud sync via 7 backends, TUI CLI, and portable DB. Runs as Tauri v2 desktop, Docker container with web dashboard on :3456, or WASM/GitHub Pages SPA.

steps: 1. Import: import_file/scan_directory/upload_file/import_from_url → infer MIME → save file to disk → FileNode in redb (files table) + parent_index → add_document to Tantivy
2. Encrypt (optional): encrypt_file → PqcEngine: ML-KEM encapsulate(pk) → HKDF-SHA256 derive ChaCha20 key → ChaCha20Poly1305 encrypt → FileEncryptedData to .enc.meta.json → FileNode.encrypted=true
3. Compress (optional): compress_file → TripleCompressor: LZ4 probe (ratio>0.98? skip) → Zstd → Brotli → CompressionStats returned → original optionally deleted
4. Index: All file changes trigger add_document/remove_document on Tantivy → BM25 index updated → searchable via search_files/suggest with fuzzy/phrase/boolean queries

5. Face Detect: detect_faces → BLAKE3-seeded 512-dim embedding → SimHash index query_candidates → cluster_auto (BruteForce/SimHash/ChineseWhispers/HDBSCAN) → FaceGroup in redb → FileNode.face_group_ids
6. GPS/EXIF: extract_exif_gps → kamadak-exif parse → Location in redb + FileNode.gps_lat/lon → get_geo_files shows on MapView (MapLibre GL)
7. Sync: start_sync → SyncPipeline: scan→compress(preview→upload→link→optionally delete raw) → FileRelation recorded → SyncProgress with ETA → .cybermanju portable DB also uploaded
8. Transfer: transfer_files → reads source backend file → streams to destination backend → progress callbacks → TransferState updated
9. Portable DB Recovery: store_compressed_for_recovery → triple-compress → BLAKE3 dedup → .cyb3 blob file → RecoveryEntry in redb → get_recoverable_data decompresses on demand
10. Trash: delete_file → TrashItem in trash table → FileNode removed from files table + parent_index → list_trash shows → restore_from_trash moves back → empty_trash purges
11. Share: generate_share_link → random 32-byte base64url token → ShareLink in share_links → /api/shared/{token} GET → get_shared_file returns file
12. Version: create_file_version → FileVersion with snapshot_data (optional) → list_file_versions → revert_file_version restores FileNode metadata

auth: JWT tokens via jsonwebtoken crate + HMAC-SHA256
server_impl: Embedded Rust HTTP/1.1 (no external HTTP framework dependency)
response_format: snake_case JSON (transformed to camelCase by frontend useTauri.ts transformResponseKeys)
lifecycle: Starts in lib.rs run() before Tauri builder, stops after .run() returns via dashboard.stop()

layout: [0..32) magic | [32..36) header_json_len (u32 LE) | [36..+h) header_json (PortableHeader) | [+h..) body (triple-compressed redb, optionally encrypted with EncryptedFileMeta)]
blobs: Sidecar directory {filename}.cyb3/ for compressed file contents, {filename}.prev/ for preview thumbnails
encryption: Optional: pack() wraps compressed body with EncryptFileMeta (KEM ciphertext + nonce) before writing. unpack() decrypts on read.

ML-KEM-1024.encrypt: mlkem1024::encapsulate(pk) → (shared_secret, kem_ct) → HKDF-SHA256(None, shared_secret) → 32B ChaCha20 key
ML-KEM-1024.decrypt: mlkem1024::decapsulate(ct, sk) → shared_secret → same HKDF → same key → ChaCha20 decrypt → BLAKE3 verify

Hybrid ML-KEM-768+X25519.encrypt: mlkem768::encapsulate(pk) → (pq_ss, kem_ct) + X25519 DH(ephemeral_sk, static_pk) → HKDF(pq_ss ∥ x_ss) → 32B ChaCha20 key
Hybrid ML-KEM-768+X25519.decrypt: mlkem768::decapsulate(ct, sk) → pq_ss + X25519 DH(sk, ephemeral_pk) → same HKDF → ChaCha20 decrypt → BLAKE3 verify
Hybrid ML-KEM-768+X25519.note: X25519 static SK derived deterministically from ML-KEM SK via HKDF(b'cybermanju-x25519-static-derivation', mlkem_sk)

triple_compress: data → LZ4 compress → if ratio > 0.98: return original (incompressible, skip remaining) → Zstd compress(level=15) → Brotli compress(level=11) → output
triple_decompress: data → Brotli decompress → Zstd decompress → LZ4 decompress → original
individual: Each layer (LZ4, Zstd, Brotli) usable independently via compress_data(data, layer_name)

pipeline: detect → embed → SimHash index → cluster → FaceGroup store
auto_select: n ≤ 200 → BruteForce (O(n²·d), exact) | 200 < n ≤ 1000 → ChineseWhispers (O(n·k·I), graph label propagation) | n > 1000 → SimHash (O(n·d·B + n·c·d), LSH-accelerated) | HDBSCAN available via explicit strategy
simhash_math: P[collision] = 1 - arccos(similarity)/π per table; with 3 tables + hamming_dist=1: ~97% recall at cos_dist=0.3
medoid: argmin_x Σ_y d(x,y) — actual data point (not mean), Kaufman & Rousseeuw 1987
